subject: Post-demo stakeholder playbook & next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Priya Malhotra <priya@healthgrid.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo stakeholder playbook & next steps

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Short recap from my side and a proposed playbook to get HealthGrid through procurement and security review by the end of September.

Run-of-show recap:
- Live demo: model routing, latency targets, and private deployment options (VPC + HSM).
- Pricing sketch: Reserved capacity + usage hybrid (we'll formalize in a quote).
- Key ask from your side: validated decision criteria, list of procurement contacts, and a security checklist schedule.

Stakeholder mapping (as we discussed):
- Economic buyer: Priya Malhotra (VP Product)
- Security/Compliance: to be confirmed — you mentioned a recurring security review on Aug 12
- Procurement: procurement@healthgrid.com
- Platform/Engineering: Alex Rivera (Clearsight) — evaluating integration surface

Decision criteria (please confirm):
- SLA for P99 latency (need target)
- Data residency & encryption (KMS/HSM) — must pass
- Unit economics at 1M tokens/month
- Support & onboarding timeline (4–6 weeks preferred)

Proposed next steps:
1) Priya: confirm procurement contact and security reviewer by Tue 2026-08-03
2) Redwood: send SOC2 summary + network diagram + deployment checklist (attached)
3) Schedule a short security sync w/ your reviewer (45 min) the week of Aug 9
4) Procurement kick-off & procurement redlines channel the week of Aug 16

Attachments: MVP-deployment-checklist.pdf (deployment tasks), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (compressed SOC2 highlights), network-architecture-diagram.png

If that aligns, I'll lock in the security sync and send a one-page mutual action plan. Looking to keep this lightweight for your S1 executive review.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Account Exec — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — helpful recap.

A few clarifications:
- Procurement contact: procurement@healthgrid.com (cc'd). Primary is Melissa Zhang (melissa.zhang@healthgrid.com) — she handles contracts and PO terms.
- Security lead: that will be Jonah Patel (jonah.patel@healthgrid.com). He’s out most of next week but can meet Aug 12 as suggested.
- Decision criteria: add data lineage & audit logs to the list — our compliance team will require replayable logs for 90 days.

We'd like the SOC2 and architecture diagram before Jonah's sync. Please also include a short note on data retention settings and log export mechanisms.

I'll coordinate schedules with Melissa and Jonah and confirm the sync time by Aug 3.
